_readme: BITCAS site configuration. All image coordinates are NORMALISED to 0..1 so the
config survives a change of capture resolution. Run `python calibrate.py` to
generate the roi / counting_lines / calibration blocks by clicking on a frame.
Values below are safe defaults that work uncalibrated: the ROI is the whole
frame and one counting line sits across the middle.

calibration._note: image_points are 4 normalised frame points on the road surface; world_points are the SAME points in metres on the ground plane, measured with a tape at the site. Order must match.

congestion._note: capacity and free_flow_kph must be calibrated from your own first week of data. free_flow_kph = 85th percentile of observed speeds during a light hour.
